name: search
title: Search
summary: People search everything they can see across installed features from one box (⌘K on web, a screen on mobile); agents get the same search as a tool.

env.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT
env.doc: How long each feature gets to answer a search (100ms to 10s); slower ones are reported as missing from the results.

env.name: SEARCH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: Searches allowed per user per minute.

stitch: Implement app.SearchProvider in each feature with searchable content, with exactly the permission checks of its list routes; kinds are prefixed with the module (docs.page) and links are app paths that exist on web and mobile. Org-scoped hits set OrgID and Context (app.SearchContext(orgName, container), e.g. "Acme · #general") and filter to app.SearchOrg(ctx) when it is set (search drops other orgs' hits either way).

Kind and feature names and icons for every belt feature ship with search; rename or add your own with registerSearchKindLabel / registerSearchProviderLabel (packages/shared) and registerSearchIcon (web and mobile @/features/search/icons) at module load.

With orgs installed, call registerSearchScope in stitching (web and mobile) so search covers the active org by default with an "All …" toggle: registerSearchScope(() => { const { org } = useActiveOrg(); return org ? { id: org.id, name: org.name, allLabel: `All ${orgsNoun("many")}` } : null; }).
Decide where search sits: the ⌘K palette and top-bar button are on every signed-in web screen; on mobile it is a Home row, promote it to a tab if search is a primary destination.
Tune SEARCH_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT to the slowest provider you accept; slower ones are reported as missing, never waited on.
